extra_quotes: The electrical response was characterized using a pulse-based measurement protocol.

Immediately after every programming pulse, a non-interfering read pulse ofV read =100 mV was applied and the remanent resistance (RREM) was calculated asR REM = Vread Iread ,whereI read is the current measured during the read pulse.
The device yield was 75% (12 out of 16 devices) for the reference structures and 33% (5 out of 15 devices) for devices incorporating AgNPs.

The lower yield of the Ag-modified structures was primarily associated with short-circuited devices, indicating that incorporation of the metallic nanoparticles introduces additional fabrication constraints.
